data.name: Mattithael
data.gender_notes: Mattithael is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew 'Mattiyahu' meaning 'gift of God'. In the Bible, Matthew was a disciple of Jesus and an author of the New Testament. The name Mattithael carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mattithael usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mattithael belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mattithael total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: מתיתאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מתיתאל הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'מתנה אלוהים גדולה ויקרה מאוד'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'מתנה' (מַתָּנָה) שפירושה 'מתנה', ו'אל' (אל) שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הק komunidades היהודיות והנוצריות כאחד, ומשקף את הקשר בין האדם לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ματθιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ματθιήλ είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει 'Δωρεά Θεού μεγάλη και πολύτιμη'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'Δωρεά' (δωρεά) που σημαίνει 'δωρεά', και 'Θεού' (Θεός) που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιείται στην Εκκλησία Ορθόδοξη και Καθολική, και αντανακλά τη σχέση μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Matthithiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Matthithiel est nomen Latinum quod significat 'Donum Dei magnum et pretiosum'. Nomen constat ex duobus verbis: 'Donum' quod significat 'donum', et 'Dei' quod significat 'Deus'. Hoc nomen in Ecclesia Christiana usu venit, et relationem inter hominem et Deum reflectit.

in_english.name: Mattithael
in_english.meaning: Gift of God, great and precious
in_english.long_meaning: Mattithael is a Christian name that originates from Hebrew roots, signifying 'Gift of God, great and precious'. The name is composed of two elements: 'Mattith' which means 'gift' and 'El' which means 'God'. This name reflects the spiritual significance of being a divine gift, symbolizing the connection between humans and God. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian denominations, representing a profound meaning that transcends cultural boundaries.

In the Bible, Matthew was a disciple of Jesus and an author of the New Testament. He was a vital witness to the life, ministry, death, and resurrection of Jesus. The name evokes the spiritual ideals of faith, sacrifice, and the pursuit of wisdom and knowledge. It can also serve as a reminder of the spiritual journey that each Christian embarks upon, and the eternal gift of salvation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mattithael, meaning "gift of God" in Hebrew, symbolizes the belief that every person is a unique and precious creation of the divine. This name invites us to recognize and cherish the divine spark within ourselves and others. It is a reminder of God's loving presence and generosity towards us.
